verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair axis for a Git forge, but the evidence describes only the hosted service at git.cafe. It contains no installation, configuration, upgrade, or maintenance documentation for running your own instance. Mirroring a branch with another Git server is an adjacent feature, not self-hosting of GitCafe.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can install, configure, upgrade, and maintain my own instance on my infrastructure
